big: The FY27 Budget was framed after Operation Sindoor in May 2025. Priorities moved to air defence, drones, counter-drone systems, missiles and next-generation platforms. Policy tells you where orders may go.

lines: Why do these niches matter for investors?
Combat-proven indigenous systems strengthen export credibility. The market rewards companies in these niches. But it also prices them richly, so the good news may already be in the price.
